name: DAZN
verdict: Owned by Access Industries, Inc.. Nothing found.
note: Rating note: majority-owned by Access Industries (Blavatnik); Companies House shows Sir Leonard Blavatnik as the person with significant control of Dazn Sports Media Limited (notified 7 August 2026).
